title: What does mallworld smell like?
content: My house in mallworld always has at least one room that is so damp and moldy I can smell it. The floors are soft and it’s musty. It’s usually a basement but sometimes it’s got like a weird staircase that leads to an attic also. My house is like Victorian with big a backyard and it’s alway being renovated, usually by my husband but sometimes there’s other ppl who are familiar but idk who they are. Anyone else have vivid smells?
